seo.title: Privacy policy | AquaVant
seo.description: How AquaVant AS handles personal data on aquavant.no.

page.intro1: How AquaVant AS handles personal data on this website. Last updated [date].

s2.text1: AquaVant AS (org. no. {{orgno}}), Oslo, Norway, is responsible for the personal data described here. Contact us at
s2.text3: This website does not use cookies, analytics or tracking. Fonts, images and video are served from our own website, so your visit is not shared with third parties such as Google.
s2.text4: When you send us a message, we receive your name, email address, organisation (if given) and your message. We use this only to answer your enquiry and to follow up any collaboration it leads to. The legal basis is your consent and our legitimate interest in replying to enquiries (GDPR article 6(1)(a) and (f)).
s2.text5: The form sends your message through our web host, Netlify, Inc. (USA), which stores it and forwards it to our email. Netlify processes the data on our behalf under its data processing agreement, which includes the EU standard contractual clauses for transfers outside the EEA.
s2.text6: We keep enquiries for as long as needed to handle them, and no longer than [12 months] unless they lead to an ongoing collaboration. Messages are deleted from Netlify within the same period.
s2.text7: You can ask for access to, correction of or deletion of your personal data, and you can withdraw your consent at any time. Email us at the address above. If you believe we handle your data unlawfully, you can complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).
